text: {"assertions":["A corrupted scaffold issue was identified in cli/commands/init.py affecting clients still pinned to the v1 SDK.","The root cause of the corrupted scaffold was connection pool exhaustion under burst load.","The corrupted scaffold manifested as a generated tree missing one file.","The fix involved raising the connection pool ceiling and adding a bounded wait queue in front of it, implemented in PR #3143 on branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-1.","The corrupted scaffold issue could be reproduced by running init into a directory that already has a lockfile.","Implementing the fix reclaimed 62 GB of blob storage."]}
